name: plugin.arch_linter
description: Codebase coupling/cohesion analyzer, circular import detector, and clean architecture boundary verifier
author: Brain Harness Forge Engine

entrypoints.name: detect_circular_imports
entrypoints.description: Scan a Python directory, build the internal module import graph, and detect circular import cycles

entrypoints.name: compute_module_coupling
entrypoints.description: Compute afferent (Ca) and efferent (Ce) coupling and instability metrics for package modules

entrypoints.name: verify_clean_boundaries
entrypoints.description: Verify that inner architectural layers (e.g. kernel, domain) do not import from outer layers (e.g. ui, cli)

parameters.name: layer_hierarchy
parameters.description: Ordered layers from core to edge (e.g. ['kernel', 'services', 'plugins', 'cli', 'ui'])
